scope: Proposition 5.1 (Strong intertwining from annulus regularization) of the manuscript “Strongly rational unitary vertex operator algebras and conformal nets” (preprints/Strongly-rational-unitary-vertex-operator-algebras-and-conformal-nets-September-25-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 280 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b5f09142bda3ec3d), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 23-24. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let V be simple, unitary and strongly rational, and let M, N, K be grading-restricted unitary V -modules, with N strongly integrable. Let Φ be an intertwining operator of type (︁ K M N )︁ , and let a ∈ M be homogeneous. Assume that Φ(a, z) satisfies the transport domination hypothesis of Lemma 4.5. Smear Φ(a, z) against a smooth test f supported in an interval I, with a fixed argument branch. If J is disjoint from I, then the closed smeared operator Φ(a, f) strongly intertwines the diagonal smeared observables of 23 N and K supported in J. This holds for every homogeneous observable in V and for every such choice of tests and argument branches.
